verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents an incident timeline that feeds automated post-mortems. It also says it automatically syncs all events between Slack and the dashboard, so alerts, acknowledge/resolve actions and Slack discussion are plausibly captured. Nothing in the evidence shows the timeline can be edited or annotated afterwards. missing for 10: documented ability to edit or annotate the timeline after the incident, explicit docs on what timeline entries contain (alerts, responder actions, chat decisions), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, the incident timeline is captured automatically — alerts, actions, and chat decisions — and I can edit or annotate it afterwards

citations.quote: Get an automated post-mortem based on the incident timeline and Slack.
